title: Platform package manifest (per-project)
description: Built at PLATFORM_PACKAGING (distribution/platform-package.json). Per target language/channel, the upload-ready metadata a human authorizes at RELEASE_AUTHORIZATION: templated title/description (with chapter timecodes), tags, resolved channel, and the exact final-video artifact hash it binds to. Describes an upload a human MAY perform once authorized; nothing here uploads.

targets.description: One entry per language/channel to publish.

video_path.description: Project-relative path to the deliverable video the upload would send.

video_sha256.description: The exact final-video hash the release authorization binds to.

chapters_timecodes.description: Rendered YouTube description timecode block, if chapters exist.

guide_path.description: Project-relative path to the per-project how-to guide rendered for this target.
